_about: SHELF of German literature in English before 1931, for works no other shelf holds: Sotheby's Oberon of Wieland (1798), Edda Middleton's Grillparzer Sappho (1858), Bertha Schimmelfennig's Storm Immensee (1902), and four Frenssen novels (Jörn Uhl, Holyland, Peter Moor's Journey, Klaus Hinrich Baas). Ellen Frothingham's Sappho waits on her shelf (only a 1972 facsimile scan); Upton's Immensee scan does not name him; the Francke anthology is on german-classics. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 95); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only. 'sotheby', 'ward' and 'hamilton' alone are left out: the first is shared with the homer and virgil shelves, the others are common surnames.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
